name: trend
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: pullback
rule: trend_up and RSI crosses above 40; continuation after retracement
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: breakout
rule: close>previous 20-bar high and ATRn<.03; volatility expansion
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: mean_regime
rule: range, z<-2, RSI<30; reversion only in range regime
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: cross_momentum
rule: top momentum quintile, ret16>0 and trend_up; relative leadership
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: relative_btc
rule: BTC-relative ret16>.01 and trend_up; outperform BTC
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: compression
rule: prior compression and close>prior high; expansion after compression
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: range
rule: range, close<prior low and z<-1.5; range bounce
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: volume_anomaly
rule: volume_z>3, positive return, taker buy>.6; demand anomaly
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: hybrid
rule: trend breakout or range reversion; causal regime switch
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: ml
rule: chronological calibrated model positive probability and positive EV lower bound
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time

name: microstructure
rule: DISABLED: historical order-book spread and depth not available
stop: 2 ATR at signal close; 3 ATR trail updated after close
target: 3 ATR or mean at signal time
